title: MULTI-BENCH: A MULTI-TURN INTERACTIVE BENCHMARK FOR ASSESSING EMOTIONAL INTELLIGENCE ABILITY OF SPOKEN DIALOGUE MODELS
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating the emotional intelligence (EI) of Spoken Dialogue Models. Although one of the example conversation scenarios mentioned in the user profile examples involves 'the Bible', this is simply a topic used for dialogue interaction and is not part of a systematic evaluation of religion, faith, ethics, or morals.
